## Relative Wealth Index

```{r}
#| label: setup-rwi
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/rwi/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: rwi-data
#| include: false

rwi_gpkg <- list.files(spatial_dir, pattern = "rwi\\.gpkg$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
rwi_data <- if (!is.na(rwi_gpkg) && file.exists(rwi_gpkg)) {
  sf::st_read(rwi_gpkg, quiet = TRUE)
} else NULL

rwi_area_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "rwi_area\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)[1]
rwi_area_std_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "rwi_area_standardized\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)[1]

rwi_area <- if (!is.na(rwi_area_file) && file.exists(rwi_area_file)) {
  read_csv(rwi_area_file, col_types = cols())
} else NULL

rwi_area_std <- if (!is.na(rwi_area_std_file) && file.exists(rwi_area_std_file)) {
  read_csv(rwi_area_std_file, col_types = cols())
} else NULL

# Map palette and breaks from layers.yml
rwi_palette <- layer_params$rwi_standardized$palette
rwi_breaks <- layer_params$rwi_standardized$breaks
rwi_labels <- layer_params$rwi_standardized$labels
```

### Standardized RWI Distribution

```{r}
#| label: rwi-histogram-standardized
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(rwi_data) && "rwi" %in% names(rwi_data) && nrow(rwi_data) > 0) {

  rwi_std_plot <- filled_histo(
    x = rwi_data$rwi,
    breaks = c(-Inf, -1, -0.5, 0.5, 1, Inf),
    palette = rwi_palette,
    labels = rwi_labels,
    domain = c(-2, 2)
  ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Relative Wealth Index Distribution in", city),
      x = "Standard deviations from national mean",
      y = "Count",
      fill = "RWI"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "right")

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "rwi-histogram-standardized.png"), plot = rwi_std_plot, device = "png",
         width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(rwi_std_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  print_text(glue("{paste_bold(round(min(rwi_data$rwi), 2))} to {paste_bold(round(max(rwi_data$rwi), 2))} (mean: {paste_bold(round(mean(rwi_data$rwi), 2))})"))
  print_text(glue("{paste_bold(nrow(rwi_data))} grid cells in AOI"))

  if (!is.null(rwi_area_std)) {
    print_paged_df(rwi_area_std)
  }

} else {
  print_text(paste_bold("No RWI data available"))
}
```

### City-Relative RWI Distribution

```{r}
#| label: rwi-histogram-relative
#| results: asis

if (!is.null(rwi_data) && "rwi" %in% names(rwi_data) && nrow(rwi_data) > 0) {

  # High-resolution histogram with equal interval coloring
  rwi_range <- range(rwi_data$rwi)
  eq_breaks <- seq(rwi_range[1], rwi_range[2], length.out = 6)
  eq_labels <- paste0(round(eq_breaks[-6], 2), " – ", round(eq_breaks[-1], 2))
  eq_palette <- c('#009E7A', '#70C5AD', '#FFFFBA', '#FF9169', '#ED431B')

  rwi_data$eq_bin <- cut(rwi_data$rwi, breaks = eq_breaks, labels = eq_labels, include.lowest = TRUE)

  rwi_rel_plot <- ggplot(rwi_data, aes(x = rwi, fill = eq_bin)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, boundary = 0, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(eq_palette, eq_labels), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = round(eq_breaks, 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Relative Wealth Index Distribution in", city),
      x = "RWI",
      y = "Count",
      fill = "RWI"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "right")

  print(rwi_rel_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "rwi-histogram-relative.png"), plot = rwi_rel_plot, device = "png",
         width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = "print")

  if (!is.null(rwi_area)) {
    print_paged_df(rwi_area)
  }

} else {
  print_text(paste_bold("No RWI data available"))
}
```
